context: This criteria evaluates how well the engineer uses react-compiler-runtime's instrumentation APIs to implement a performance debugging tool. The focus is on correct usage of renderCounterRegistry, clearRenderCounterRegistry, and $structuralCheck functions to build a comprehensive debugging utility.

checklist.name: Uses renderCounterRegistry
checklist.description: Uses the renderCounterRegistry Map from react-compiler-runtime to access render counter data for tracking component renders

checklist.name: Registry manipulation
checklist.description: Correctly adds entries to renderCounterRegistry with proper structure (Map<string, Set<{count: number}>>), tracking individual counter objects for each component

checklist.name: Uses clearRenderCounterRegistry
checklist.description: Uses the clearRenderCounterRegistry function from react-compiler-runtime to reset all counters to 0

checklist.name: Counter increment logic
checklist.description: Implements proper counter increment logic that initializes to 0 on first call and increments on subsequent calls for each component

checklist.name: Uses $structuralCheck
checklist.description: Uses the $structuralCheck function from react-compiler-runtime to detect structural differences between old and new values

checklist.name: Correct $structuralCheck parameters
checklist.description: Passes all six required parameters to $structuralCheck in correct order: oldValue, newValue, variableName, fnName, kind, and loc

checklist.name: Report generation
checklist.description: Generates performance report by iterating through renderCounterRegistry and aggregating render counts from the Set of counter objects for each component
